modality_identification.description: Identify the medical imaging modality shown in the image.
modality_identification.require: This task applies whenever the imaging modality can be reliably determined from the annotation, image metadata, or dataset description. A dataset containing only one modality is still sufficient for generating this task.

view_identification.description: Identify the imaging view, projection, plane, or acquisition orientation.
view_identification.require: This task requires a view, projection, or plane field with values such as CC, MLO, AP, PA, lateral, axial, coronal, or sagittal.

laterality_identification.description: Identify the anatomical side represented in the image or containing the target finding.
laterality_identification.require: This task requires a laterality field with values such as left, right, or bilateral.

image_quality_assessment.description: Determine whether the image has sufficient diagnostic quality or identify the primary image-quality issue.
image_quality_assessment.require: This task requires a quality or artifact field with values such as diagnostic, non-diagnostic, motion artifact, blur, underexposure, or overexposure.

anatomy_identification.description: Identify the primary anatomical structure, organ, or tissue shown in the image.
anatomy_identification.require: This task applies whenever the depicted anatomy can be reliably determined from the annotation, image metadata, or dataset description. A dataset containing only one anatomical category is still sufficient for generating this task.

anatomy_attribute.description: Determine a global anatomical or tissue-level characteristic that is not specific to a focal finding.
anatomy_attribute.require: This task requires a structured anatomy-attribute field such as breast density, organ size, tissue composition, parenchymal pattern, or anatomical development stage.

finding_presence.description: Determine whether a specified imaging finding or abnormality is present in the image.
finding_presence.require: This task requires an explicit finding-presence label, abnormality label, or reliable positive and negative case annotation. Missing bounding boxes, masks, or finding annotations must not be interpreted as absence.

finding_type.description: Identify the type of abnormal imaging finding shown in the image.
finding_type.require: This task requires a finding-type field containing at least two clinically meaningful values, such as mass, calcification, nodule, effusion, fracture, asymmetry, or architectural distortion.

finding_attribute.description: Identify a morphological or visual characteristic of a specific imaging finding.
finding_attribute.require: This task requires structured finding-attribute fields such as shape, margin, distribution, texture, density, echogenicity, enhancement, or signal intensity.

finding_description.description: Describe the clinically relevant visual characteristics of a specific imaging finding.
finding_description.require: This task requires either a paired expert-written finding description or structured fields such as finding type, shape, margin, location, distribution, and imaging appearance.

assessment_category.description: Determine the standardized clinical assessment category supported by the medical image.
assessment_category.require: This task requires an assessment-category field with values such as BI-RADS 1–6, PI-RADS 1–5, LI-RADS categories, Lung-RADS categories, or an equivalent standardized system.

severity_grading.description: Determine the severity, stage, or grade of an abnormality or disease.
severity_grading.require: This task requires a severity, grade, or stage field with ordered values such as mild, moderate, and severe; grade 1–3; or stage I–IV.

diagnosis.description: Determine the most likely named diagnosis supported by the medical image.
diagnosis.require: This task requires a diagnosis field containing clinically specific disease or condition labels, such as pneumonia, fracture, fibroadenoma, cyst, invasive ductal carcinoma, or another expert-confirmed diagnosis.

pathology_status.description: Determine the benign, malignant, or other pathological status associated with the imaging finding or case.
pathology_status.require: This task requires an explicit pathology or malignancy-status field with values such as benign, malignant, atypical, high-risk, in situ, or invasive. The label may describe the target lesion or the corresponding case, but it must be explicitly provided rather than inferred from the diagnosis name.

report_generation.description: Generate a complete medical imaging report based on the provided image or image set.
report_generation.require: This task requires a paired report field containing a complete expert-written medical imaging report for each corresponding case.

detection.description: Locate a lesion or abnormal region directly from the image without being given a specific finding name or textual description that identifies the target.
detection.require: This task requires a lesion-level bounding box or mask defining the target abnormal region. The spatial annotation may be accompanied by generic lesion-presence labels or case-level labels such as benign or malignant, but it must not rely on a paired region-level finding name or textual description to specify what should be localized. A mask may be converted into a bounding box.

visual_grounding.description: Locate the image region corresponding to a finding explicitly named or described in the question.
visual_grounding.require: This task requires a region-level finding name or textual finding description paired with the bounding box or mask of that same finding. The paired text must identify which specific finding the model should localize. A mask may be converted into a bounding box.
